/typography/roles/type.title.why: 28 of 89 titles render at 31pt (the master's 34pt shrunk 90% by autofit), white Segoe UI Semibold typed in title case (written as typed, so short words stay lower case) on the navy band, two lines at most; the master sets 90% line spacing

/typography/roles/type.h1.why: 20pt is the reference's next level below the titles (11 runs); a heading set in the title face

/typography/roles/type.emphasis.why: the reference emphasises in bold at body size: the total row and the Decreased words in its tables, the bold labels in its pictured charts

/typography/roles/type.caption.why: the Note sidebar and Note lines under the charts are 11pt regular Segoe UI in black (layout placeholder idx 11 at 1100)

/typography/roles/type.footnote.why: the smallest text the reference sets is 9pt Segoe UI (its figure ID label); used for the one-line legal footer

/typography/roles/type.axis_label.why: the pictured charts set tick labels, category names and legend entries in a condensed sans at about 11 to 12pt in black

/typography/roles/type.data_label.why: values at bar ends and inside stacked segments are the same condensed sans at about 11pt, black on light fills and white on the teal

/color/roles/color.ink_muted.why: the grey of the 'Age Group' legend heading in every trend chart picture

/color/roles/color.accent1.why: the teal of the main bars, the user slice and the outer disc in the pictured charts (slides 2, 3, 9)

/color/roles/color.accent2.why: the light blue second series beside the teal (slides 2 and 3)

/color/roles/color.accent3.why: the navy of the title band and of the total-population line in every trend chart

/extra_roles/color.series_blue.why: the 12 to 17 line and the vaping-only segment

/extra_roles/color.series_red.why: the inner disc on slide 9 and the red rule's hue

/extra_roles/color.slice_grey.why: the remainder slice of the pies (slide 3)

/titles/register.why: every content title is a topic phrase built the same way (Measure: Population; Years); none states a finding; trend verdicts live in the table's Trend column

/charts.why: no native chart; the pictures set the language: bars and stacked columns with values on the marks, legend above, no gridlines; line charts with markers, legend at right, no data labels (the table carries them)

/shape_language/icon_style: small black circle icons with a white arrow for a significant trend and a hollow circle with a minus for no change, beside legend entries and in the table's trend column
/imagery/register_kind: none: no photographs or illustrations; logos only in the background picture

/description.summary: A federal statistical figure deck: one exhibit per page under a full-width navy title band, a thin red rule down the left edge, black text on white, an agency wordmark at the bottom right and the page number at the bottom left.
/description.typography: Titles 31pt Segoe UI Semibold in white on the navy band, title case, two lines; condensed sans (Arial Narrow) at 10.5 to 11pt for chart text and tables; 11pt Segoe UI for notes; a 9pt bold figure ID top left in the band.
/description.color: Navy 1F3A4D band, red D1332F left rule; charts in teal 196886 and light blue 8EB3DF, line series in navy, blue, green and maroon; grey 767171 table headers; no emphasis colour: bold carries emphasis.
/description.layout: Exhibit centred under the band in a light panel; trend pages put the table of estimates centred below the chart and a narrow Note sidebar at right above the wordmark; notes run along the bottom.
/description.tables: Compact native tables, grey header with white bold labels, no interior rules, a grey rule under the last row, numbers centred at one decimal, total row bold, Trend column with icon and word.
/description.motifs: navy title band, red left rule, figure ID label, bottom-right wordmark
not_seen: no claim titles: every title names the measure and population
no colour used to mark emphasis
/description.tone: neutral, plain, descriptive; the data speaks and the trend column states significance

/derivation_rules: New series colours take the teal, light blue and navy first, then the blue, green and maroon of the line charts; never a new hue.
Emphasis is bold weight in black, never colour.
New text roles take 9, 11, 20 or 31pt; condensed sans for exhibit text, Segoe UI for notes and titles.
Tables keep the grey header, white bold labels and a single grey bottom rule.

/continuation.why: none seen: each figure fits its page; no continued pages in the 90
